HushedBog_Text_Npc0.en: GRIMER thrives here. I do not.

HushedBog_Text_Npc1.en: Do not breathe too deep, son.

HushedBog_Text_Quest0_Ask.en: A FULL HEAL for my research. A\nPOISON BARB in return.
HushedBog_Text_Quest0_Ask.fr: Un TOUT-SOIN pour ma recherche. Un\nPIQUANT POISON en retour.

HushedBog_Text_Quest0_NoRoomT.en: Your BAG is full. Make room, then\ncome back.
HushedBog_Text_Quest0_NoRoomT.fr: Ton SAC est plein. Fais de la\nplace, puis reviens.

HushedBog_Text_ReturnAsk.en: Ready to go back to the dock?

HushedBog_Text_Stay.en: Take your time. The tide can wait.
HushedBog_Text_Stay.fr: Prends ton temps. La marée peut\nattendre.

HushedBog_Text_TopazeFindFull.en: Something shines here, but your BAG\nis full.
HushedBog_Text_TopazeFindFull.fr: Quelque chose brille ici, mais ton\nSAC est plein.
